newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan goes to London on Wednesday for talks on Gulf security and the Middle East peace process.
- Qatar and Yemen to sign security agreement soon.
- Yemen to sign a final cooperation agreement with the European Union on April 18.
- One thousand experts to take part in Qatar gas conference on March 17.
- Arabsat expects to double its profit in 1997. It made $30 million profit in 1996.
- Iran will help Syria modernise its army. The issue was discussed during a visit to Damascus by Iran's defence minister last month.
